prompt: Final pre-submission pass on my manuscript please. Flag anything wrong with the citations, the way I've described what those cited papers actually found, or inconsistent wording. It's manuscript.typ with refs.yml.

assertions.text: Flags the incorrect year for lecun2015 (bib says 2017; correct is 2015)
Flags 'K. He' as initial-only and does not expand it to a full name
Reports vaswani2017 as an orphan citation (cited but not in the bibliography)
Questions or flags the claim that silver2016 (AlphaGo) 'reduced training compute by 40%' as unsupported / needing human verification rather than accepting it
Does NOT falsely flag the accurate ResNet 3.57% top-5 error claim as wrong (leaves it or marks it verified)
Flags the mixed behaviour vs behavior spelling
Produces a clear report with severity levels and concrete suggested edits
